attackers_goals: Windows Remote Management (WinRM) enables users to interact with remote systems in different ways, including running executables on the remote endpoint. WinRM sessions can be established using winrm/winrs commands or programs such as PowerShell. Attackers can use WinRM to execute code and move laterally within a compromised network.
